notes.title: Kinetic Edge First Demo!
notes.content:
As part of Steam's Autumn festival, players will be able to get their hands on the very first public playable version of Kinetic Edge! Our upcoming physics multiplayer racing game!

The demo will offer various maps for Singleplayer and Multiplayer to play with your friends, race and compete. It comes with multiple game modes: Race, Arena and Survival! With more to come in the future.

Our community hub and discord are open for your feedback and discussions! We hope that you enjoy the game and that you follow us and wishlist to be notified of its release and closed betas in the future!

Have fun,
SCT
